notes.title: Game On: New Sports-Themed Steam Items Are Here!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, champions!

The competition is heating up, and we’ve got something special for you! Brand-new Steam community items are here! Collect exclusive trading cards, upgrade your profile with dynamic sports-themed backgrounds, and unlock emoticons and avatar frames that scream victory.

Hit the field, play your best game, and start earning these awesome rewards. Thank you for being part of our winning team!

Best regards,
Play and Cum 💦 Team[/h3]

notes.title: Hit the court – Sex Sport College 💦🏅 is live!
notes.content:

 The wait is over – Sex Sport College is officially out! Step into the role of a former pro athlete now coaching a women’s college basketball team after your sister’s sudden injury. With a tough season ahead, it’s up to you to guide this underdog team to the championship – and along the way, navigate the personal challenges and heated dynamics that unfold both on and off the court.

Meet various characters and hot girls each bringing their unique personalities and stories to the game. With choices that shape relationships and unlock steamy 18+ scenes, Sex Sport College combines athletic drama with sizzling encounters that’ll keep you coming back.
